第2章(1)
理了个小平头，穿着过大的西装外套，搭上计程车前往天信集团总公司的途中，保贝儿一直在想，这个叫掌尚勇的，他的声音……好耳熟。
难不成小时候她见过他，听过他的声音？
不对，男生小时候的声音和长大后差很多的。
他的声音好像是最近才听过，是医院里的医生？其他病患家属？还是医院地下美食街的老板……
「小姐，到了。」
「哦，好……不对，司机，我……我是男生。」她都理了平头，穿着加了厚厚垫肩的西装外套，眉毛画得又黑又粗，很像蜡笔小新，这样还像女生？
「小姐，你真爱说笑，你的声音明明是女生。」
对哦，她还没「变声」。
「司机，多少钱？」压低声音，她故意用重低音问。
司机被她突如其来的变声叮了一跳。「小姐，你原来的声音比较好听耶。」收了钱，找钱给她，司机笑呵呵的表示。
苦笑，保贝儿当然知道自己原来清脆悦耳的女声比较自然好听，可为了假扮哥哥保俊获得月薪十万的特助工作，她不得不变声啊。
下车后，仰望着天信集团的高楼，她深吸一口气，束胸还真是痛苦，她都快喘不过气来。
拉了拉过大的西装外套，她昂首大步往前行，从现在这一刻起，她不再是娇滴滴的保贝儿，而是她双胞胎哥哥保俊。
她是男人，她是男的，她是很man的男人。
============================================================
我是男人，我是男的，我是很man的男人。
从守卫到柜台小姐，保贝儿一路走来直到遇到秘书小姐，每个人一见到她，都是先愣个三秒钟，将她从头到脚打量一番，然后徽笑的对她说：「小姐，你好。」
每遇到一个人，她都要端出「正经八百」的脸孔，严正声明，「我是男的。」
原来要假扮成男人，并非如她想像中容易。

秘书小姐帮她通报后，她终于进到总裁办会室，见一只高大的熊正对着话筒吼——
「别以为我不知道你在打什么主意，你他妈的给我听清楚，一切照原价、照着合约定，否则，我会给你好看！」
保贝儿叮呆了，她不是来到天信集团的总裁办公室吗？怎么她有种误闯黑道大哥地盘的感觉？
她，要不要逃？
在她的世界里，没有这种爆粗话的人，说真的，她有点发抖，耳朵和心脏有点承受不住这种粗吼声。
正当她的脚步往后转，悄悄地想朝门边走去，身后一道疑惑恶的声音扬起——
「你是……保俊？」
想逃也来不及了。
「我……我是。」回身，眼睛对上朝她走来的大熊，她吓凸了眼，他……他不就是在义大利艺廊差点把她的脊椎骨压断的那只高大的熊吗？
这也太巧了吧！难怪她觉得他的声音很耳熟。
「你……保俊？」掌尚勇皱紧眉头，仔细地将面前的人从头到脚审视一番，除了西装外套、小平头，其他的……在在令他很难相信眼前这个人是保俊。
虽然保俊小六时是瘦小了点，但……好像没这么娘。
对，他一直觉得哪里不对劲，眼前这个人好娘！
而且，好眼熟。
「你……我是不是在哪里见过你？」
保贝儿嘿嘿千笑。「你、你当然见过我，我是你同学，读国小时我们每天都见面的，不是吗？」
这么幽默——可惜一点都不好笑。
掌尚勇沉着脸，再仔细看「他」。
他的记忆才非常好，和他仅有一面之缘的人，丰年内他绝不会忘，所以这个人是……
「对了，你长得好像我在义大利见过的一个女孩，她的名字叫……」

「Isabella。」原以为他不会记得她。没想到他的记性还不错。
「你怎么知道？」
「我猜的，我妹在义大利念书，另外她也在艺廊打工，也许你遇到的人是她。」她不确定哥哥是否有和他提过她。「我……有跟你提过我有个双胞胎妹妹吧？」
「好像有。」掌尚勇咧嘴一笑。「难怪你们长得那么像。」
「是啊，因为双胞胎嘛！」她呵呵傻笑着。看来她是过关了？
「保俊，好久不见。」
他伸出手，她立刻和他握手，要给她月薪十万的财神爷，可不能得罪，至于他那像黑道大哥的口气……忍忍吧，保贝儿，为了十万块，你要坚强点。
保贝儿咧嘴笑着，但下一刻他突然将她勾入怀中，把她当男的，大熊掌猛拍着她的背。
「保俊，这么久不见，我都不认识你了。」
「是啊、是啊6咳咳咳。」再拍下去，她会得内伤的。
「你怎么了？」
「没，我只是……有点小感冒，咳……咳……」假装咳嗽两声，免得他起疑。
「来，先坐，我们坐下谈。」掌尚勇示意她到沙发那边坐。「你喝茶还是喝咖啡？」
「咖啡。」
他按了内线，要秘书小姐泡两杯咖啡进来。
「对了，谈工作之前，我们先谈谈你妹的事。」
「我妹？」
「她有跟你们提过我在义大利艺廊不小心压伤她的事没？」掌尚勇坐在对面，越看越觉得保俊跟Isabella长得好像，除了发型不一样、眉毛粗了点、声音……怪了点，那张脸简直是同一个模子印出来的。
同性双胞胎长得一模一样，似乎比较常见，异性双胞胎也长得这么像……实在有说不出的怪。
「哦，有，她提过。」

「实在很抱歉，但我真的是不小心的，当时我问她需不需要送医。她回说她没事，后来回台湾，我有再打电话问过艺廊老板，他也说没事……」他本想再请秘书小姐再打一次电话，确认她真的没事，他才能安心，但秘书小姐忘了他交代的事。既然保俊在这里，他正好可以问他。
「我妹没事，真的！这件事你不用在意。」没想到他外表看起来大老粗一个，对于「差点」压伤她的事，他还一直耿耿于怀。
当时，他跌倒压到她的背，其实只压了她一秒钟，他很快就翻身跃起，似乎是怕伤了她。
痛是会痛，但休息一下就好了。他其实也算是负贵任的男人，一直要老板和地陪先生劝她到医院做个检查，但她的身体她自己知道，她很确定没伤到脊椎，反倒是她自己扑接陶钵趴跌在地比较痛。
「你确定？」
「我当然确定，身体是我的，我怎么会不……」对上他质疑的眼神，保贝儿立刻反应过来，干笑解释，「我是说，我和我妹是双胞胎，她的身体若有病痛，我也能感应得到。而且她也说过她没事。」
「如果真是这样就好。」他可不希望别人因他受伤，在生活上有任何困扰。「对，我还不知道你妹的中文名。」
「保贝儿，她叫保贝儿。」不管他想问什么，她都会回答。只要他赶快确定她获得那份高薪的工作。「那个，你说，要请我当特助的事……」
「对，我非常需要你的帮忙，不知道你——」
「我很乐意。」
「很高兴听到你这么说。」咧出一口白牙，掌尚勇看着腕表。下班时间到了，难怪他肚子饿得咕噜叫。「我请你吃晚餐，我们边吃边聊。」
「这个……」
「你有事？」
保贝儿猛摇头。「不，我是想说，我很乐意。」
她万般乐意，因为，她也饿了。

Chapter 2(1)
After getting a crew cut, wearing an oversized suit jacket, and taking a taxi to the head office of Tianxin Group, Bao Beier kept thinking that this guy named Zhang Shangyong, his voice... sounded so familiar.
Could it be that she had seen him and heard his voice when she was a child?
No, boys' voices are much different when they are young than when they grow up.
His voice seemed to have been heard recently. Was it a doctor in the hospital? Other patients’ families? He is also the owner of the underground food court in the hospital...
"Miss, we're here."
"Oh, okay... no, driver, I... I'm a boy." She had a crew cut, wore a suit jacket with thick shoulder pads, and her eyebrows were drawn black and thick, much like Crayon Shin-chan. Does this still look like a girl?
"Miss, you really love to joke, your voice is clearly that of a girl."
That's right, she hasn't "changed her voice" yet.
"Driver, how much does it cost?" She lowered her voice and asked in a deliberately heavy bass.
The driver was startled by the sudden change in her voice. "Miss, your original voice is nicer." After collecting the money and giving her the change, the driver said with a smile.
With a wry smile, Bao Beier certainly knew that her clear and melodious female voice was more natural and pleasant to listen to, but in order to pretend to be her brother Bao Jun and get a special assistant job with a monthly salary of 100,000 yuan, she had to change her voice.
After getting off the car, looking up at the tall buildings of Tianxin Group, she took a deep breath. The corset was really painful and she could hardly breathe.
Pulling up her oversized suit jacket, she strode forward with her head held high. From this moment on, she was no longer the delicate Bao Beier, but her twin brother Bao Jun.
She is a man, she is a boy, she is a very manly man.
============================================================
I am a man, I am a man, I am a very manly man.
From the guard to the counter lady, Bao Beier walked all the way until she met the secretary lady. When everyone saw her, they were stunned for three seconds, looked at her from head to toe, and then said to her with a smile: "Hello, miss."
Every time she meets someone, she has to put on a "serious" face and solemnly declare, "I am a man."
It turns out that pretending to be a man is not as easy as she imagined.
After the secretary informed her, she finally entered the president's office and saw a tall bear roaring at the microphone——
"Don't think that I don't know what you are planning. Listen to me clearly. Everything will be settled according to the original price and the contract. Otherwise, I will give you a good look!"
Bao Beier was stunned. Didn't she come to the president's office of Tianxin Group? Why does she feel like she's wandered into the underworld's big brother's territory?
Does she want to escape?
In her world, there were no such harsh words. To be honest, she was shaking a little, and her ears and heart couldn't bear the roar.
Just as she turned back, quietly trying to walk towards the door, a suspicious and evil voice came from behind her——
"Are you... Baojun?"
It was too late to escape.
"I...I am." Turning around, her eyes met the big bear walking towards her. She bulged her eyes in fright. He...wasn't he the tall bear that almost broke her spine in the Italian Art Gallery?
What a coincidence! No wonder his voice sounded familiar to her.
"You... Baojun?" Zhang Shangyong frowned and carefully looked at the person in front of him from head to toe. Except for the suit jacket and the crew cut, the rest... made it difficult for him to believe that the person in front of him was Baojun.
Although Baojun was a little thinner when he was in primary school, but... he didn't seem so girly.
Yes, he always felt that something was wrong, the person in front of him was such a girl!
And, it looks familiar.
"You...have I seen you somewhere?"
Bao Beier laughed a thousand times. "You, of course you have met me. I am your classmate in elementary school.We meet every day, right? "
So humorous - but it's not funny at all.
Zhang Shangyong looked at "him" carefully with a sullen face.
His memory is very good, and he will never forget anyone who has only met him once in many years, so this person is...
"By the way, you look like a girl I met in Italy. Her name is..."
"Isabella." I thought he wouldn't remember her. I didn’t expect that his memory was pretty good.
"How do you know?"
"My guess is that my sister is studying in Italy, and she also works in an art gallery. Maybe the person you met is her." She was not sure if her brother had mentioned her to him. "I...have told you that I have a twin sister, right?"
"It seems so." Zhang Shangyong grinned. "No wonder you look so much alike."
"Yes, because of the twins!" She giggled. It seems she passed the test?
"Baojun, long time no see."
He stretched out his hand, and she immediately shook his hand. She wanted to give her a monthly salary of one hundred thousand yuan, but she couldn't offend him. As for his tone that sounded like a gangster brother... endure it, Baby, for one hundred thousand yuan, you have to be strong.
Bao Beier grinned, but the next moment he suddenly pulled her into his arms, treating her as a man, and slapped her back with his big bear paw.
"Baojun, I haven't seen you for so long, I don't even recognize you anymore."
"Yeah, yeah 6 cough cough cough." If she keeps filming, she will get internal injuries.
"What's wrong with you?"
"No, I just... have a little cold, cough... cough..." Pretend to cough twice to avoid suspicion.
"Come, sit down first, let's sit down and talk." Zhang Shangyong motioned for her to sit on the sofa. "Do you drink tea or coffee?"
"Coffee."
He pressed the intercom and asked the secretary to make two cups of coffee.
"By the way, before we talk about work, let's talk about your sister."
"My sister?"
"Did she tell you that I accidentally crushed her at the Italian Art Gallery?" Zhang Shangyong sat across from her. The more he looked at her, the more he felt that Baojun and Isabella looked similar. Except for their different hairstyles, thicker eyebrows, and... weird voices, their faces were almost printed from the same mold.
It seems to be relatively common for twins of the same sex to look exactly the same. Twins of the opposite sex also look so similar...it's really weird.
"Oh, yes, she mentioned it."
"I'm really sorry, but I was really careless. I asked her if she needed to be sent to the hospital. She said she was fine. Later when I returned to Taiwan, I called the gallery owner again and he said she was fine..." He originally wanted to ask the secretary to call her again to confirm that she was really fine so that he could feel at ease, but the secretary forgot what he told her. Now that Baojun is here, he can just ask him.
"My sister is fine, really! You don't have to worry about this." Unexpectedly, he looked a bit rough on the outside, and he was still brooding over the incident of "almost" crushing her.
At that time, he fell and pressed on her back. In fact, he only pressed her for a second. He quickly turned over and jumped up, as if he was afraid of hurting her.
It hurts, but it will be fine if you rest. In fact, he was a man with a high responsibility, and he kept asking his boss and Mr. Li to persuade her to go to the hospital for a check-up. But she knew her body well, and she was sure that her spine was not injured. On the contrary, it was more painful for her to catch the pottery bowl and fall to the ground.
"Are you sure?"
"Of course I'm sure, the body is mine, how could I not..." Facing his questioning look, Bao Beier immediately reacted and explained with a dry smile, "I mean, my sister and I are twins. If she is sick, I can feel it. And she also said that she is fine."
"It would be great if that were the case." He didn't want others to get hurt because of him and have any trouble in their lives. "Yes, I don't know your sister's Chinese name yet."
"Paul Belle, her name is Paul Belle." No matter what he wanted to ask, sheAll will answer. As long as he hurry up and make sure she gets that high paying job. "Well, you said you wanted to ask me to be your special assistant..."
"Yes, I really need your help. I didn't know you-"
"I'd love to."
"I'm glad to hear you say that." He bared his white teeth and looked at his watch. It was time to get off work, no wonder his stomach was growling with hunger. "I'll treat you to dinner, and we'll talk while we eat."
"This..."
"What's wrong with you?"
Bao Beier shook her head violently. "No, I want to say that I'm happy to."
She was very happy because she was also hungry.
